classification_note: Categories and mappings are inventory metadata, not semantic proof. The inventory records first-pass root-level and scenario-to-RT crosswalks, individual role mappings for all 242 prototype-tree files across eight families, a first-pass relationship review of all 136 scenario-named reports, and bounded evidence-graph reviews for RT-04-01 and the Dependency Graph/Logos Lean family. B-02b.1–B-02b.5 add current Lean proof, Python test-evidence, scenario-overlap, orphan, and inventory-reconciliation slices. These reviews do not validate every claim, test outcome, generated artifact, or experiment environment; corpus-wide claim validation and reproducibility review remain open.
